node.statement: Coordinate calculation: define iota_C(z)=sum_j z_j Pi_j. The relations in node 1.7.1 give iota_C(1,...,1)=1, iota_C(zw)=iota_C(z)iota_C(w), and iota_C(conjugate(z))=iota_C(z)*. Linear independence makes iota_C injective and spanning makes it surjective. Hence it is a unital *-isomorphism C^k->B.
